tools.name: jasmin_list_companies
tools.description: The companies (legal entities) of the Jasmin subscription: key, name, tax id, country and base currency.

tools.name: jasmin_get_company
tools.description: One company by its key: name, tax id, address, base currency.

tools.name: jasmin_list_customers
tools.description: Customer records: party key, customer group, payment term, payment method, currency and flags. Names and tax ids are on the party: use jasmin_list_parties or jasmin_get_customer.

tools.name: jasmin_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by its party key, with the party data (name, tax id, address, contact).

tools.name: jasmin_list_sales_items
tools.description: Items and services that can be sold: item key, unit, tax schema, type and price lists. Descriptions are on the item: use jasmin_get_sales_item.

tools.name: jasmin_get_sales_item
tools.description: One sales item by its item key, with the item data.

tools.name: jasmin_list_parties
tools.description: All business parties (customers, suppliers and others) of the subscription with name and tax id.

tools.name: jasmin_get_party
tools.description: One business party (customer or supplier) by its party key.

tools.name: jasmin_list_payment_terms
tools.description: The payment terms (for example 30 days) defined in the subscription.

tools.name: jasmin_list_sales_invoices
tools.description: Sales invoices (billing): document type, series, number, date, customer, amounts and status. Filter and order with OData, for example filter "buyerCustomerParty eq 'ACME'" and orderby "documentDate desc".

tools.name: jasmin_get_sales_invoice
tools.description: One sales invoice by its id, with document lines and taxes.

tools.name: jasmin_get_sales_invoice_by_number
tools.description: One sales invoice by its document number: company, document type, series and series number.

tools.name: jasmin_list_credit_debit_notes
tools.description: Sales credit and debit notes (memos), with the same filter and order options as invoices.

tools.name: jasmin_get_credit_debit_note
tools.description: One sales credit or debit note by its id.

tools.name: jasmin_list_sales_orders
tools.description: Sales orders: document number, date, customer, amounts and status.

tools.name: jasmin_get_sales_order
tools.description: One sales order by its id, with document lines.

tools.name: jasmin_get_sales_order_by_number
tools.description: One sales order by its document number: company, document type, series and series number.

tools.name: jasmin_list_sales_quotations
tools.description: Sales quotations: document number, date, customer, amounts and status.

tools.name: jasmin_get_sales_quotation
tools.description: One sales quotation by its id, with document lines.

tools.name: jasmin_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: Purchase orders: document number, date, supplier, amounts and status.

tools.name: jasmin_get_purchase_order
tools.description: One purchase order by its id, with document lines.

tools.name: jasmin_list_supplier_invoices
tools.description: Supplier invoices received (invoice receipt): supplier, date, due date, amounts and status.

tools.name: jasmin_get_supplier_invoice
tools.description: One supplier invoice by its id, with document lines and taxes.

tools.name: jasmin_list_receipts
tools.description: Customer receipts (payments received): number, date, customer, amount and payment method.

tools.name: jasmin_get_receipt
tools.description: One customer receipt by its id, with the invoices it settles.
